tools.name: grant_access
tools.description: Grant a specific identity the ability to decrypt escrowed content. Only available for proofs created with content escrow opted in (not yet available — stamps are hash-only today). Returns a capability token the grantee uses with reveal.

tools.name: reveal
tools.description: Retrieve escrowed content for a proof you have been granted access to. Only available for proofs created with content escrow opted in (not yet available — stamps are hash-only today). The service re-checks H(content) == stampedHash before returning.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_account, buy_stamps · Private data: create_account, create_proof, get_balance, buy_stamps, list_proofs, revoke_proof, grant_access · Public sink: create_account, create_proof, revoke_proof.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_account, buy_stamps · Private data: create_account, create_proof, get_balance, buy_stamps, list_proofs, revoke_proof, grant_access · Public sink: create_account, create_proof, revoke_proof

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
